_doc: Pixel art components for the town (docs/ART.md). size = target art pixels per frame (w x h). ref = component whose finished image must be used as the design reference.

components.name: 勇者 設定画（正面・背面・横）
components.prompt: MANDATORY STYLE: DESIGN ONLY from user-hero-3-b.png. Before generating open with view_image ./party-style-hero-b.png (existing companions FRONT and BACK) and ./user-hero-3-b.png. REDRAW as the same family as the existing party: about 2.5 heads tall, LARGE head, SHORT compact body and legs. Draw directly on a 32x40 art-pixel grid, then enlarge NEAREST NEIGHBOUR. Crisp ONE art-pixel dark purple/brown outline, clean vivid FLAT colours, large readable clusters. NO gradients, shading texture, blur, high-resolution detail, averaging or shrinking the reference. B DESIGN: swept-up spiky GOLDEN TAN/BROWN hair (NOT red and NOT pure bright yellow), large brown eyes (both front eyes identical 2px wide, 3px tall, identical white highlight). No headband. TEAL scarf and short flowing TEAL cape ending at upper calves with sparse gold border; BLUE armour with GOLD trim and short blue skirt plates, silver/ivory small sleeves, brown belt and gloves, brown trousers/boots, blue sword scabbard on wearer left hip, straight silver sword with plain gold crossguard. Hair has 4-5 chunky irregular upward tufts, not a famous character silhouette. Armour BLUE ramp ONLY: #323353 #484a77 #4d65b4 #4d9be6. Cape/scarf TEAL ramp ONLY: #0b5e65 #0b8a8f #0eaf9b #30e1b9. Keep these as TWO INDEPENDENT material ramps, not shared with hair, eyes, skin, leather, metal, magic or bedding. Warm golden brown hair/leather, gold trim, brown eyes, fixed silver sword. All frames SAME head/body proportions and SAME pixel size. ONE horizontal row, generous pure #00FF00 gaps so sword and spark never overlap neighbouring poses; flat pure #00FF00 background. No labels, no ground, no shadows. All full boots visible. THREE standing neutral poses: straight FRONT equal eyes; straight BACK no face; strict RIGHT profile one eye. Sword sheathed. Front and back invented consistently from side design. Cape covers back armour with clear gold edge; do not invent a logo.
components.use: デザインの基準。町で立ち止まった時（正面・背中・横）

components.name: スライム（待機2・被弾）
components.prompt: Adapt the supplied four-view jelly reference into exactly THREE FRONT-facing poses: idle; squash breathing; hurt with closed eyes. Blue-green translucent jelly with a tall softly WAVY top, multiple blunt rounded ripples, rounded little side lobes, a broad puddle base, pale mint internal face region, two small dark oval eyes, peach blush cheeks and visible circular air bubbles. Keep the reference's friendly chunky substantial volume, NOT the previous tiny flat amber three-lobed jelly. NO pointed teardrop apex, curled tip, broad red smile, red lips or copied game monster. Render translucency with solid pixel clusters, no actual alpha translucency on the body, no gradients. Make idle body occupy about 29-32px WIDTH and 27-29px HEIGHT inside the existing 34x30 cell, feet/puddle on bottom baseline; breathing remains at least 24px tall. It must read clearly as an enemy in field battles. Resurrect 64 turquoise/mint/cyan, 12-16 colours, one-art-pixel selective outline, top-left highlights, flat shading. Consistent scale and volume, one row, no ground shadow.
components.sub: 正面（戦闘フォーカス用）
components.use: 戦闘画面：待機・被弾

components.name: おばけ（待機2・被弾）
components.prompt: A small mischievous white ghost monster with a wavy tail, dark hollow eyes, open mouth with a little tongue, faint lavender shading. Frames: idle; floating one pixel higher with the tail waving the other way; hurt, flinching.
components.sub: 正面（戦闘フォーカス用）
components.use: 戦闘画面：待機・被弾

components.name: しれんのゴーレム（待機2・被弾）
components.prompt: A stone golem trial guardian: bulky grey stone blocks with moss, glowing red eyes, a golden rune core in the chest, huge fists. Frames: idle; slight breathing with the core glowing brighter; hurt with cracks and recoil.
components.sub: 正面（戦闘フォーカス用）
components.use: 戦闘画面：待機・被弾

components.name: ドラゴン（待機2・被弾）
components.prompt: Adapt the supplied four-view green dragon reference into exactly THREE FRONT-facing boss poses: idle; small wings raised; hurt recoiling with one eye closed. Retain moss/olive green scales, cream segmented belly, short ivory horns and dorsal spines, cream wing membranes with GREEN ribs, amber eyes, broad gentle-fierce muzzle, thick curled tail, planted clawed hind feet and seated upright chibi posture. NO purple wings, tail flame or copied game monster. Make a substantial boss, idle roughly 78-92px wide including wings and 68-73px tall in existing 110x75 cell, visibly larger than hero/slime. Wings remain small relative to chunky torso. Simplify scales to clean flat clusters rather than noisy texture. Resurrect 64 green/olive/ivory palette, same one-art-pixel selective outline and top-left lighting as town sprites. Same body/head size in all poses, planted feet on common baseline, one row with generous gaps.
components.sub: 正面（戦闘フォーカス用）
components.use: 戦闘画面：待機・被弾

components.name: 宿屋の奥の壁（窓・ランタン）
components.prompt: The back interior wall of a cosy medieval inn, a wide low horizontal strip: warm wooden plank wall, two small CLOSED glass windows with warm yellow light, a wall lantern, a small shelf with a mug. Continuous solid wood wall across the centre, no doors, no doorways, no openings. The entrance is at the FRONT of the room on the viewer side, outside this image. No arches, no dark entrance-like recesses. Interior back wall only, no floor, no roof. A clean horizontal rectangle.
components.use: 宿屋の中の奥の壁

components.name: 宿屋のベッド（空き）
components.prompt: Exactly the same wooden inn bed as in the reference, same angle, same size, same red-and-white checkered quilt, but EMPTY: the pillow is plumped and the quilt is neatly folded down, nobody in it.
components.use: 空きベッド（寝ている勇者のベッドと同じ大きさ）

components.name: 宿屋のじゅうたん
components.prompt: A rectangular red woven rug with a gold border pattern, seen from above, flat.
components.use: 宿屋の中の飾り

components.name: きょうかいの奥の壁（ステンドグラス）
components.prompt: A 264 by 64 art-pixel rectangular back INTERIOR wall panel of a peaceful medieval JRPG church, about FOUR times wider than tall, same pixel scale and front/slightly overhead perspective as the inn wall reference. Pale cream stone blocks and simple slim stone columns at the ends. One SMALL arched CLOSED stained-glass WINDOW placed HIGH in the upper part of the wall, blue and gold glass with a small red jewel. The window occupies only the upper half of the panel: its glass and frame end well ABOVE the floor. Draw a clearly projecting HORIZONTAL STONE WINDOWSILL under the glass. Beneath that sill, the ENTIRE lower third is an uninterrupted solid stone dado / waist-high wall of at least TWO visible courses of masonry across the centre, with a continuous baseboard along the bottom. The window must read as a raised WINDOW, NEVER a floor-to-ceiling arch, doorway or door. No doors, no doorways, no openings, no dark passages. The entrance is at the FRONT of the room on the viewer side, outside this image. Flat wall only, no roof, exterior building, floor, altar or foreground. A clean horizontal rectangle that can be repeated side by side.
components.use: 宿屋と同じ幅の室内の奥に3枚並べる壁。上部のステンドグラス窓と窓台、下部は連続した腰壁

components.name: きょうかいの祭壇
components.prompt: One small medieval JRPG church ALTAR, front view with a slight top-down angle, same 16-bit pixel style as the town furniture. A cream stone rectangular altar table with a white cloth trimmed in gold and blue, a small golden cross and an open book resting on top. Simple clean clusters, not an elaborate cathedral. The entire altar alone, no floor, wall or people. Approximately twice a standing hero's width, table surface near the hero's waist.
components.use: 祈る勇者の奥に置く祭壇

components.name: きょうかいの長椅子
components.prompt: One wooden church pew for a 16-bit JRPG town interior, warm walnut and gold-brown timber, simple long horizontal seat with a low backrest and two sturdy ends. Front view from slightly overhead, visitors would face toward the back of the room. Same perspective as the inn beds and furniture, clean chunky pixels. One empty bench only, no floor or wall or characters.
components.use: 中央の通路を空け、左右に並べる長椅子

components.name: きょうかいのじゅうたん（奥・継ぎ目なしの中・手前）
components.prompt: THREE equal-width rectangular sections of ONE continuous blue church carpet runner, straight top-down view. Deep blue centre, simple gold side stripes, small gold diamond motifs. Frame 1: the FAR/TOP cap with a gold horizontal border ONLY at the top, open blue bottom. Frame 2: the MIDDLE repeat tile, gold stripes ONLY on the left/right, absolutely NO top/bottom borders, NO fringe, NO horizontal edge or shadow. Frame 3: the NEAR/BOTTOM cap with a gold horizontal border ONLY at the bottom, open blue top. The exact same left/right edges and blue colours in all frames, perfectly vertical and rectangular, no perspective taper. Frame 2 top and bottom pixels must match seamlessly, so stacking top + many middles + bottom forms ONE long carpet without visible joins. Rug sections alone, no furniture, characters, floor or wall.
components.use: 画面手前の入口から祭壇まで、奥の端＋真ん中の繰り返し＋手前の端で1本につなぐ

components.name: きょうかいの燭台
components.prompt: One small freestanding golden brass church candelabrum in 16-bit JRPG pixel art, front view with a slight top-down angle. Three short white candles on curved arms, tiny warm yellow flames, a slender gold stem and sturdy base. Same pixel scale as the town's standing hero, about one hero tall. Clean readable silhouette, no particles, glow haze, floor, wall or people.
components.use: 祭壇の左右に置く燭台

components.name: 神父さま（待機2コマ）
components.prompt: A kind elderly village church PRIEST NPC, facing the viewer, immediately recognizable as a Christian cleric, same pixel scale, chibi proportions and selective outline style as the hero reference, but NOT the hero's costume. Wear a TALL POINTED BISHOP'S MITRE, cream-white with gold edges and a clearly readable GOLD CROSS decoration on its front; the tall hat is the defining silhouette. Silver side hair, short white beard and friendly small eyes below the hat. Wear a LONG cream-white clerical ROBE reaching the feet, blue trim at the hem, and a GOLD STOLE: TWO distinct long vertical bands draped from BOTH shoulders down the front almost to the hem, with small blue cross decorations. Hands calmly folded at the waist between the hanging stole ends. No weapon, no staff. Two almost identical idle frames: eyes open; gently blinking with a tiny robe highlight change. Feet, hat, head position, silhouette and size stay anchored, no jumping. Keep the ENTIRE priest including the mitre about the same height as the standing hero. One priest alone in each frame, no altar, furniture, floor, glow or effects.
components.use: 祭壇のそば。クリックで一言を順番に話す（MP・やすむの案内を含む）

components.name: ぼうけんのしょ（セーブクリスタル、光る4コマ）
components.prompt: A floating cyan save crystal (a tall diamond-shaped gem) hovering above a small stone pedestal, glowing. Four animation frames: the crystal bobs up and down by one pixel and its inner glint and the surrounding light sparkles rotate.
components.use: git（冒険の書に記録）の時に祈る

components.prompt: A small campfire on crossed logs surrounded by a ring of stones. Four animation frames of the flames flickering (orange, yellow, white core), with a few sparks.

components.name: 地面（町の草・野の草・石畳・土・床板）

Low contrast textures, no outlines, no objects.

components.name: villageの格子地面
components.prompt: Exactly FIVE separate square 48x48 logical-pixel ground samples in ONE horizontal row on pure magenta #FF00FF, generous magenta gaps. Order: 1 muted rich olive grass, seamless; 2 darker leafy grass clumps, seamless and same background color as sample 1; 3 ochre packed earth with an overlapping olive grass lip; 4 warm gray rectangular cobbles with a dark gray curb; 5 deep blue water with a brown earthen bank. Samples 3,4,5 each have a 3 pixel wide material border on ALL four sides and square corners, with a flat tileable inner 32x32 surface. Border is a physical grass/sand lip, curb, bank, not a black cartoon outline. Light top-left, shadow below/right. Ground must be readable low-contrast flat clusters, not noisy flecks. Texture features 2-6 logical pixels wide; stones 8-12px, water horizontal 4-8px waves. No perspective, no bevelled UI buttons, no objects, no labels. Original 16-bit JRPG map materials; limited palette 12-16 colors, sharp 1px art grid, no gradients, blur, antialiasing or drop shadows.
